commands.name: get_state
commands.description: Read the FM-1: connection, tempo, swing, playing, the six tracks (sound, engine, volume, mute, loop length in steps, speed, echo and reverb sends, and their steps: melodic tracks as text like "C2 . C2 - D#2 .", drum tracks as [lane, "x...x..."] rows) and the three user sample slots USR1-3, and the echo / reverb settings (fx). Call this first and after the person has been playing with it by hand.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Connect to the FM-1 over USB if it isn't connected yet (the page normally does this itself).

commands.name: list_sounds
commands.description: The FM-1's sound engines and the sounds (presets) each has, by name. DRUM and DRUM-X sounds are drum kits; SAMPLE plays samples, including the user slots USR1-3.

engine.description: Only this engine, e.g. DRUM, ANALOG, FM6, SAMPLE.

commands.name: set_sound
commands.description: Give a track a sound by its name (as list_sounds shows; a part of a name is enough). For drums pick a kit from DRUM or DRUM-X. Tracks 5 and 6 can't play GRAIN or PHYS.

engine.description: Optional: only look in this engine.

commands.name: set_steps
commands.description: Write a melodic track's pattern. One token per step (16th notes at speed x1), separated by spaces: a note like C3, F#2, Bb4; a chord joined with + (C3+E3+G3); "." for nothing; "-" to hold the note before it; ">" in front accents (">C3"). The number of tokens becomes the loop length (1-64). Middle C is C4. Bass lines sit around C1-C3.

commands.name: set_drums
commands.description: Write a drum track's pattern by lane. Each lane is a string of steps: x a hit, X an accented hit, . nothing. Lanes: kick, snare, clap, hat (closed), openhat, tom, rim, bell. The longest lane sets the loop length (1-64). The track should have a DRUM or DRUM-X kit (set_sound).

commands.name: set_track
commands.description: Change a track's loop length (steps), speed (x0.25-x4 against the song tempo; x1 normal, x2 double, x0.5 half: other values drift against the other tracks), volume (0-127), mute, its own swing (0-100), and how much it sends to the echo and the reverb (0-100 %).

commands.name: set_kit
commands.description: A drum track's parts one by one: level (0-100 %) and pitch (tune, semitones -12..+12, in 3/16 steps) of kick, snare, clap, hat, openhat, tom, rim, bell. get_state shows each drum track's kit. Level 0 silences a part without touching its steps.

commands.name: clear_track
commands.description: Remove every note or hit from a track (its sound stays). The person can undo on the FM-1 by holding SAVE.

commands.name: set_tempo
commands.description: The song tempo in BPM (40-240).

commands.name: set_swing
commands.description: Swing for every track, 0-100 % (about 50-66 gives a shuffle feel).

commands.name: set_fx
commands.description: The echo and reverb every track sends to (set_track echo / reverb sets how much each sends). echo_time is a note value: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 8T, 16T, 1/2, 1/1, 2BAR, 4BAR, 1/8D, 1/16D, 1/4D (D dotted, T triplet). echo_feedback 0-100 %: how long the repeats go on (high = a long slow tail). reverb_size 0-100 %.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Start the FM-1 playing.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the FM-1.

commands.name: set_song
commands.description: Give a track a list of parts the FM-1 plays in turn in song mode (up to 16), each repeated 1-16 times; the list goes round and round. pattern: "A" is what the track plays now, "rest" is silence, any other name is a variant given in variants: {from: "A", transpose: semitones} (a copy moved up or down), {steps: "..."} (as set_steps) or {lanes: {...}} (as set_drums); any variant can add kit: {hat: {tune: 2}} to pitch a drum part (semitones) for that part, A keeping the pitch it has now. Each track's list is its own, so lists of different lengths drift against each other. Stops the FM-1 and turns song mode on. Example: parts [{pattern:"A",reps:2},{pattern:"B",reps:1}], variants {B:{from:"A",transpose:2}}.

commands.name: song_mode
commands.description: Song mode: on (each track walks its list of parts round and round), once (through once, then stop), off (each track loops the part it's on).

commands.name: get_song
commands.description: Song mode and each track's list of parts.

commands.name: find_media
commands.description: List the sound and video files in a folder on the PC (with their sizes), to choose one for load_audio. With no folder: the person's Music folder.

commands.name: load_audio
commands.description: Load a sound or video file from the PC into the sampler (it replaces what's loaded). Returns its length and a loudness profile, one figure per half second (0 silent - 9 loud), to help choose a passage.

commands.name: audio_info
commands.description: The loaded sound's length, the current selection and the loudness profile (one figure per half second, 0-9).

commands.name: trim_audio
commands.description: Select the passage to sample, in seconds from the start of the loaded sound. A user slot holds about 7.4 s at high quality, 14.8 s at long, 20 s at longest.

commands.name: send_sample
commands.description: Send the selected passage to a user sample slot on the FM-1 (USR1-3), normalised with tiny fades. quality: high (22 kHz, up to ~7.4 s), long (11 kHz, ~14.8 s, duller), longest (8 kHz, ~20 s, telephone-like). Replaces what the slot held. Takes up to half a minute.

commands.name: save_sample
commands.description: Keep the selected passage in My samples (Music\Coracle Samples) without sending it to the FM-1. send_sample keeps a copy there too.

commands.name: list_samples
commands.description: The samples in My samples (everything sent to the FM-1 or saved), newest first, with their paths for load_audio.

commands.name: use_sample
commands.description: Make a track play a user sample slot (it becomes a SAMPLE track). Notes on it play the sample: C4 at its own pitch, higher notes faster and higher. For a long passage write one note held with "-" for its length.
